description: This file contains helper functions for extracting MAC addresses from specific device configurations related to the Phicomm K2T, such as loading configuration data from MTD partitions and parsing JSON data.

methods.name: k2t_config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration data from the MTD partition named 'config', reads its size, and loads the JSON content.

methods.name: k2t_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address associated with a given key from the loaded configuration.
